profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Pegasystems
profile.summary:
I am a natural-born problem solver with high attention to detail and 20 years of IT Infrastructure experience

A software engineer specializing in development and support of scalable Infrastructure As Code,  automation, and provisioning projects that simplify deployment of complicated cloud and on-prem  environments. I thrive when challenged and want to develop software that makes life easier for infrastructure engineers.

Specialties include infra tools such as terraform and ansible, bash and powershell scripting, container platforms like kubernetes and docker swarm, security, agile and scrum, and DevOps.
